'''The Tomb''', also known as the '''Deep Prison''', was a massive [[Prison/Legends|prison]] complex created by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It was later converted into a part of the wider [[Belsavis prison]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
It was discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] fifty years before the [[Great Galactic War]] and converted into a Republic prison by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]]. During the Great War it was used to house [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], and [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]]. During that war, the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] sent strike teams to the planet in an attempt to free its members from their imprisonment.

At one point, Executor [[Krannus]] intended to overload the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] power core located in the lower levels which would have created a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] ripple that would have destroyed the entire star system.
